identity_check: Confirmed as Cognite (cognite.com; Cognite AS in the site footer, Cognite Holding B.V. in the Schneider Electric release), the Aker-backed industrial DataOps and AI software company founded in 2017 with Dr. John Markus Lervik as CEO and co-founder; products Cognite Data Fusion, Atlas AI and Flows. Every round page names the same company (Aker as majority shareholder, customers bp / Saudi Aramco / Alfa Laval). Big change since our list was made: on 2026-06-30 Schneider Electric signed a definitive agreement to buy 100% of Cognite for $3.1B all-cash, to be merged into AVEVA; completion was still pending regulatory approvals in every page read. Category kept adjacent, layer plant_ops: Cognite is the contextualized data layer plus an agent workbench (Atlas AI) sold to large energy, process-manufacturing and power operators, which overlaps Utopian's maintenance / process-stability agents in intent but not in buyer, deployment model (enterprise platform) or channel (no procurement / RFQ / WhatsApp front-line agents). HQ recorded as US because the company says it established its global headquarters in Arizona in 2025 (Norwegian origin noted in conflicts).

open_items: Total equity raised found: $225M (Accel $75M Series A 2020 + TCV $150M Series B 2021), matching Cognite's own '$225 million raised from ... TCV and Accel'. Aker's founding capital and the Aker convertible loan (converted before the TCV close; a NOK 0.62bn convertible is settled in the Schneider deal) were not found as dated rounds.
Accel round: exact announcement day not confirmed (Business Wire release returned 403); amount $75M comes from SiliconANGLE and Cognite's $225M total; post-money $550M from Aker's Q3 2020 report.
TCV round: Aker says the round 'values Cognite at USD 1.6 billion' without saying pre- or post-money; recorded as post-money. Aker said closing was expected early June 2021.

Aramco 2022 secondary: price (around NOK 1bn / ~$113M) and 'just over $1.5 billion' valuation are from OE Digital only; recorded valuation in USD and left amount null because no money went to Cognite. Energy Voice article (403) not read.

Schneider Electric acquisition: completion not confirmed in any page read on 2026-10-30 ('expected to be completed in the coming quarters'). Aker's stake percentage at sale not disclosed; Aker's estimated cash proceeds USD 1.48bn including the convertible loan settlement.
Revenue: FY2025 'exceeded $170 million' is described by Cognite as preliminary and unaudited; earlier annual revenue not found.
Pricing not public in pages read.
